reference_boundary: The case mapping alone reaches admission/evaluation/policy. The sibling reference object is source-hand-derived metadata and is never passed to visible_state, run_policy, or evaluate.

reference.basis: One ordinary one-hop Soldier deploy into an empty neutral tower; compare no action. Arrival tick uses 120 logical ticks per 30 seconds and normal Soldier speed.
